scope: Independent read-only review of the new passive river-temperature estimate. Frozen hydraulic velocities, face discharges, source NOAA fields and masks must remain unchanged.
status: Method and boundary-source review passed; full-week transport diagnostics and final encoded visual acceptance remain pending.

method.state: A depth-averaged, fully mixed cell temperature tracer in the pre-existing steady hydraulic field, initialized from the first hourly discharge-weighted lake inlet temperature.
method.carrier: Use original signed native face discharges and cell water volumes h times 50 m times 50 m, never display-enhanced particle motion.
method.equation: V dT/dt = sum(Qin Tup) + Qext,in Tin - sum(Qout T) - Qext,out T + r T, where r is the unchanged hydraulic solution's small local continuity residual.
method.residual_compensation: The r*T_new term is explicitly accounted for in the inventory ledger and evaluated implicitly. It preserves uniform temperatures and Celsius/Kelvin offset invariance without refitting raw hydraulic flow. It is a numerical continuity treatment, not physical heating.
method.scheme: First-order implicit donor-cell transport on the head-ordered acyclic flux graph; each nonzero edge points from higher to lower hydraulic head. Positive incoming weights and the storage term yield a bounded scalar mixing operator.
method.boundary: All finite-volume cells, including inlet cells, evolve. External inflow/outflow is inferred from signed internal divergence at designated open boundaries. Boundary inflow supplies the actual hourly scalar forcing; inlet cells are not hard-pinned with unaccounted stored heat.
method.no_heat_exchange: Atmospheric, bed and tributary heat exchanges, stratification, time-varying hydraulic flow and calibrated dispersion are not represented. Grid-cell donor mixing is numerical, not a measured turbulent diffusivity.

boundary_source_review.independent_method: Brute-force containment in every supplied original NOAA triangle and independent scalar barycentric interpolation; no use of the preparer's Matplotlib triangle finder.
boundary_source_review.uncovered_treatment: One shoreline cell, carrying 0.04445% of total inflow, uses the contemporaneous discharge-weighted mean from covered inlet cells. This is a declared boundary approximation.

initialization_and_coverage.reason: The full domain volume divided by discharge is about 6.90 days, a bulk flushing scale rather than a channel travel-time observation. Quiet cells can retain much of the assumed initial state across this week; 1,403 wet cells have exactly zero stored internal face flow.
initialization_and_coverage.disclosure: Colors in such cells represent the source-derived assumed initial temperature, not proof that contemporaneous inlet water reached them. Track and publish initial-state fraction through time and show the dependence on a different uniform initial temperature.
initialization_and_coverage.linearity_sensitivity: For this linear operator, changing the uniform initial temperature by delta shifts each cell temperature by delta times its remaining initial-state fraction. This can quantify initialization sensitivity without claiming that delta bounds real atmospheric thermal error.
initialization_and_coverage.mask: A valid pre-existing wet cell may retain an explicitly assumed initial temperature. Do not expand into disconnected source-water polygons or land, create new current coverage, replace null source cells, or force a transport connection.

required_numerical_checks: Uniform-temperature preservation and Celsius/Kelvin offset invariance.
No clipping; temperatures bounded by boundary and initial-state range to stated numerical tolerance.
Initial-water fraction between zero and one to numerical tolerance.
Native inventory changes equal external flux plus explicitly reported continuity compensation at each step and cumulatively.
Halved time-step comparison on the same boundary and initial state; interpret residual numerical error separately from unvalidated physical assumptions.
Frozen hydraulic, lake-source and display-mask hashes unchanged; compact output maps exactly to original valid river cells.
River-temperature ISO time axis matches the lake's 169 endpoints exactly, and regular-grid geometry/source river hash matches the renderer's field.
Preserve every finite actual NOAA temperature, including zero; supplement only missing river temperature and never change velocity or source priority.

footer_and_documentation.suggested_detail: Fixed 12-17 Oct flow; advected hourly lake temperature; no heat exchange
footer_and_documentation.preserve: Simplified, unvalidated depth-averaged-flow disclaimer; same fixed <=12 to >=16.5 C palette, with estimated temperature identified in the river.
footer_and_documentation.name: Passive temperature-tracer estimate or advected lake-outlet temperature estimate.
footer_and_documentation.avoid: Do not call this measured river temperature, a validated surface-temperature forecast, a coupled transient lake-river thermal model, or observed travel time. No navigation-safety claim.

primary_physics_sources.supports: Control-volume transport of heat concentration, advection and mixing, and time-step accuracy/stability considerations. This review does not claim to implement HEC-RAS.
Full water-temperature models separately account for atmospheric and sediment heat exchange and require meteorological forcing; passive transport omits those physical sources and sinks.
